Register a solver for the Hill fit

Source: R/fit_solvers.R
register_solver.Rd

Records a solver under a name so it can be listed with get_solvers(). Any function with the solver_drc signature can be passed to fit_drug_response_metrics(solver = ) whether or not it is registered; the registry is a menu.

Usage

register_solver(
  name,
  fn,
  description = NA_character_,
  available = function() TRUE
)

Arguments

name

string, the solver's name.

fn

the solver function.

description

string, what it does.

available

function of no arguments returning TRUE when the solver can run (e.g. its package is installed). Defaults to always available.

Value

NULL, invisibly.

Examples

register_solver("drc", solver_drc, "drc::drm, L-BFGS-B within the model bounds")
names(get_solvers())
#> [1] "drc"
